svg.text: • SCARS? no → lichen simplex chronicus · yes → sclerosus or planus

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • IN THE VAGINA (or mouth)? yes → planus · no → sclerosus

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • ITCH ++++ with no scar → simplex chronicus · PAIN > itch → planus

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • all three: biopsy to confirm, ultrapotent steroid ointment
